owned_invariants: Two terms agree only if their values on every panel assignment, their costs and their normal-form trees all agree.
The battery checks sequential and parallel associativity, both units, composition against a two-step run, and symmetry only where it is declared.
A battery over the bound is refused as BATTERY_TOO_LARGE, never truncated silently.
A panel with no sample for a needed colour is refused as NO_SAMPLES.
boundaries: A pass covers the supplied operations on the supplied panel; it is not a proof for all terms.
Two refusals count as equal outcomes whatever their codes, because the two runs meet errors in different orders.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed vocabularies from the canon, checked arithmetic, no unwrap or direct indexing.

basis.G1: Module header declares AuthorityEffect None and the contract URN; public items match this contract and code/rust/pfp_operads/README.md. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond the README and docs/plans/operads_redesign.md.

basis.G3: Refusals are typed; one modulo index and one swap are bounds-justified in comments. Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.

The one survivor disables the composite-versus-two-step value comparison, which cannot fire while substitute and eval are correct. clippy -D warnings and rustfmt pass.
